title: Embeddings onboarding capsule: rerank pipeline explainer + compact screenshots
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, copy-first onboarding capsule for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart that will be embedded in the docs and Console onboarding flow. Deliverables: a simplified pipeline diagram, two compact mobile/desktop screenshots for the Console quickstart card, annotated sample outputs (before/after rerank), and export-ready Figma frames for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: One simplified pipeline diagram (SVG + PNG) that fits an 820x360 hero slot and a 480x280 card slot
Two annotated screenshots: Console quickstart card (desktop) and compact mobile card with visible CTA, model selector, and sample outputs
Sample output panel with clear 'input -> raw embeddings -> rerank results' labels and at least 3 example items showing score deltas
Figma file with redlines and copy tokens exported to the docs team; all frames named for automated asset ingestion
PRD/Confluence links included in ticket; designer has responded to PM/Eng review comments
Hand-off checklist completed and assets uploaded to the release folder in Drive
No blocking accessibility issues identified (contrast, alt text)
assets_needed: Annotated sample outputs JSON + screenshot overlays
Figma frames exported as PNG + SVG, with tokens
tasks: Draft pipeline diagram showing: ingestion -> embedding generation -> vector index -> rerank step -> scored results
Produce two screenshot variants and add live copy from Docs team
Run quick accessibility sweep (contrast + alt text)
Get PM signoff on copy and sample outputs
Export assets to Drive and update Confluence with new links
Create small PR with image assets to docs repo and add example snippet
decisions: Use a horizontal left-to-right pipeline for hero, stacked variant for small card
Show concrete numeric scores for rerank (normalized 0-1) instead of raw distances to improve comprehension
Keep example dataset generic (support tickets) to avoid customer data leakage
Use muted teal for embeddings step and warm orange for rerank highlight to draw attention to improvement
